label: Week 1
method: Saturday rollup of nightly search_news + counts; items already filter-passed; no invented nights
headline: Week 1 opened with the Patriots–Seahawks rematch owning the board all week, then the 49ers–Rams Australia kickoff kept San Francisco and Los Angeles loud through the Melbourne blowout. Dallas–New York, Chicago’s opener buzz, Buffalo’s home-opener noise, and Philadelphia’s Graham farewell were the other sticky rooms. New Orleans stayed in the mix on Cam Jordan’s absence and local voice Mike Detillier’s death; Houston’s swarm hype rounded out the top volume tier. All seven nights logged. Quiet clubs stayed quiet. Vibe only.
